note: Declared capabilities the router may hand to an already-approved adapter. A declaration is a pointer to existing, verified code. It is not a second skill engine, not a copy of any skill, and not an execution grant. Undeclared tracks (GZH vendor, X, XHS) are deliberately absent: they are rights-blocked or unmerged, so resolving them returns UNKNOWN_SKILL rather than a permissive answer.

scope_conventions.accounts: '*' matches any requested account for routing only. It is not permission to execute on, or across, accounts.
scope_conventions.pipelines: An explicit list. A requested pipeline outside the list is OUT_OF_SCOPE.
scope_conventions.stages: An explicit list. A requested stage outside the list is OUT_OF_SCOPE.
scope_conventions.execution: No scope value, including '*', ever authorizes execution. Resolution stays a pointer; the adapter and the M5 gate decide separately.
